Loops.Title: Loops
Loops.Explain: A loop is the agent repeating think → call a tool → read the result until the task is done or a limit stops it. Every task runs under the limits below, and changes apply to the next message without a restart.
Loops.Limits.Title: Limits
Loops.Steps.Label: Step limit per turn
Loops.Steps.Help: The most model round trips one message may take before the agent stops and asks. 1 to 200, default 24.
Loops.Result.Label: Longest tool result sent back
Loops.Result.Help: Longer tool output is cut to this length before the model reads it. 1,000 to 200,000, default 16,000.
Loops.Context.Label: Context budget before compaction
Loops.Context.Help: When a request would pass this size, old tool results are shortened and earlier turns are summarized. 0 turns it off; otherwise 8,000 to 1,000,000, default 64,000.
Loops.Coming.Title: What's coming
Loops.Coming.Budgets.Title: Token and cost budgets per task
Loops.Coming.Budgets.Body: Stop a task when it has spent a set number of tokens or money.
Loops.Coming.Plan.Title: Plan first
Loops.Coming.Plan.Body: Write a task list before the first tool call.
Loops.Coming.Verify.Title: Verify step
Loops.Coming.Verify.Body: Check the result before saying the task is done, and reopen the loop if the check fails.
